directional-profile.rationale: The explanatory profile consistently distinguishes the longer antispinward reach from the shorter spinward reach.

weapon-mode-gate.rationale: Conventional rocket and deployed Longbow states show the directional guidance while cruise and Chord modes remain excluded.

presentation-accessibility.rationale: Wrapped minimap copies, arrows, text, selection copy, and ARIA communicate the directional envelope without relying on color alone.

authoritative-targeting.rationale: The displayed envelope remains explanatory while preview and firing retain canonical trajectory, visibility, terrain, power, and cooldown checks.

onboarding.rationale: First Contact reaches the real deployed Longbow Siege Mortar action, and the developer-reviewed initial human cohort completed the comprehension criteria.

regression-scope.rationale: Focused simulation, browser acceptance, full repository checks, and the veteran-mirror cohort passed without introducing excluded launch-scope behavior.
